title: Easily Auto-Post to Google My Business Profile from WordPress - Bit Social

facts.fact: Bit Social can share WordPress content to multiple social accounts such as Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn simultaneously.

facts.fact: The page says a Google Business Profile can be connected to Bit Social in two ways: One Click and Custom App.
facts.quote: You can do this in two ways– **One Click** and **Custom App**.

facts.fact: Bit Social's WP Auto Post feature automatically shares new WordPress posts to a Google Business Profile and other connected platforms when they are published.
facts.quote: automatically share your WordPress posts to your Google Business Profile and other connected platforms the moment you publish new content

facts.fact: In Bit Social's WP AutoPost settings, enabling 'Share posts automatically' shares the post on all active social accounts automatically.
facts.quote: Enable the “**Share posts automatically**” option, to share the post on all active social accounts automatically.

facts.fact: Bit Social's 'Share post delay' setting controls when posts are shared after they are published on WordPress.
facts.quote: Set “**Share post delay**”, this tells when your posts will be shared after publishing on WordPress.

facts.fact: The page's Google Business Profile scheduling tutorial is structured as ten steps.
facts.quote: **Step 10:** From the Logs section you can visit the shared post and see other details.

facts.fact: Bit Social's Share Now feature allows instantly sharing a post to a Google My Business account.
facts.quote: allows you to instantly share your post on Google My Business account

facts.fact: In the WP Post Schedule feature, WordPress content can be filtered by category and tag before being shared to Google My Business.
